mappings.parent_claim_text: The physical three-disk flow, semiclassical periodic-orbit constructions, exact-quantum determinants, and classical transfer determinants are differently typed objects despite shared geometry or coding.
A physical-roof certificate at d=6a requires an exact object map connecting collision coding, geometry evaluation, roof regularity, normalization, operator space, and determinant convention.
Euler, periodic-trace, and Fredholm-determinant agreement is an internal roof-agnostic calibration for a consistently typed roof and is not evidence of physical-roof fidelity.

A defensible determinant enclosure requires orbit-tail, rank/projection, quadrature, and roundoff components plus a separately propagated geometry/roof-input uncertainty, all expressed in a common norm with stability and determinant-conditioning control.

Livsic-type periodic-data reasoning is asymmetric: after exact hypotheses are matched, a certified mismatch may obstruct one predeclared relation, while finite agreement cannot prove global equivalence.

The six-gate methods program consists of physical-roof construction, operator eligibility, a common coefficient map, a five-channel common-norm error theorem, typed physical-fidelity controls, and theorem-licensed nontransfer.
The contribution is a falsifiable physical-determinant methods and error-contract article rather than a computed determinant result or an arithmetic candidate claim.
Phase-6 report revision cannot alter the fixed route boundary A0_FAIL / A2_NOT_ELIGIBLE / NO_ROUTE_PROMOTION, and Route B remains closed.
